result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would ensure universal access to quality education—especially for those who are currently marginalized or excluded due to poverty, geography, gender, or conflict.  

Education is transformative: it empowers individuals to think critically, make informed choices, improve their livelihoods, and participate meaningfully in society. It ripples outward, leading to better health outcomes, stronger economies, more resilient communities, and more peaceful societies.  

By guaranteeing that every person, regardless of circumstance, has the tools and opportunity to learn and grow, we wouldn’t just change lives—we’d fundamentally reshape the trajectory of humanity toward greater equity, understanding, and progress.
